fields.Name: IT07 - Dataset Cache (DatasetCache category)
fields.Description: Exercises the dataset cache through GetAndCacheDatasetByName. DS1: a cold call populates the cache (IsDatasetCached false->true) and a warm call serves the same dataset. DS2: the status APIs (IsDatasetCached / IsDatasetCacheUpToDate) agree with the warm state. DS3: after ClearDatasetCache both status APIs return false (a cleared dataset is never reported up-to-date). DS4: the warm fetch is SERVED from the cache rather than silently refetched - a sentinel is written into the cached blob's Status (leaving every per-entity row count untouched, so freshness still holds) and the warm call must return it; DS1-DS3 cannot distinguish a served call from a refetch, which is how the warm path stayed dead from 987a126aab until ProviderBase.DatasetCacheCategory. Assertions are behavioral, not counter-based: the dataset cache writes through the provider's own LocalStorageProvider (separate from the instrumented LocalCacheManager), so counters can't observe it on the server. Uses the test-only 'IT_DatasetCache' dataset (metadata-optional/integration-test/datasets), whose tables only metadata sync writes: 'MJ_Metadata' spans the core metadata tables, so any other bundle's or MJAPI background job's write between DS1 and DS2 made the cache stale by design (#6190). No row mutation.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Cold miss writes the DatasetCache category; the warm hit is served from it (proved by sentinel, not by row-count equality); status APIs agree; clearing the cache flips both status APIs back to false.
